title: Stratified Multi-View Aggregation for Score Distillation
abstract: Score distillation turns a pretrained 2D diffusion model into a 3D generator, but the per-step gradient is estimated from a single random view: this one-sample estimate has high variance (different views of the same partial scene disagree) and is blind to global shape consistency. Existing multi-view approaches address this by retraining the diffusion prior on multi-view data; this improves consistency but conflates the sampling contribution with the quality of the retrained prior. We instead isolate the sampling axis, leaving the prior frozen. We introduce Multi-View Aggregated Score Distillation (MV-SDI), a training-free sampler that replaces the single-view per-step gradient with an average over K views at a fixed UNet-call budget. Averaging K views lowers the per-step gradient variance toward 1/K of its single-view value. Drawing the K views as antithetic antipodal pairs adds no further variance reduction (measured antipodal correlation rho approximately 0) but stratifies angular coverage (every step covers both hemispheres) removing the same-hemisphere clustering of independent sampling. At a fixed 10,000-UNet-call budget on the 43-prompt SDI benchmark, K=2 halves the optimization steps and raises CLIP R-Precision from 74.8% to 83.8% and CLIP score from 0.297 to 0.312 over the single-view SDI baseline, with consistent gains on HPSv2 and ImageReward and a 0.0% divergence rate. K=4 gives a fourfold step reduction at R-Precision 86.9% and CLIP 0.307. The gains concentrate on hard prompts where single-view distillation collapses, at a measured cost in CLIP-IQA. MV-SDI is drop-in for gradient-based score-distillation pipelines, including Score Distillation via Inversion and plain SDS, and requires no retraining and no multi-view data. Code is available at: https://github.com/marianlupascu/MV-SDI

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2606.29964v2 的 31 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: 本次 v2 保留 6 月 v1 的 camera aggregation 方法和主表，新增 SDS/MVDream 对照、多视角 prior 的 aggregation 负结果、五个 VLM judge 及重新设计的 seed 核验；实质价值是扩展证据并收紧适用范围。 把每步single-view SDI改为K个view梯度平均，antipodal pairing保证同step覆盖两半球；不重训2Dprior，gradient accumulation保持memory。值得读camera-sampling与budgetcontrols，但所谓2–4×只指optimizersteps，equal-budgetwall-clock相同；作者报告promptalignment提高、CLIP-IQA下降23%，不证明Janus/shape整体改善或新priorSOTA。
analysis.motivationZh: Frozen 2D prior 的 score distillation 每步只监督一个视角，更新受视角差异影响，跨视图形状也可能冲突。问题是隔离 camera sampling 本身的作用，并在相同 UNet 调用预算下厘清聚合带来的收益、质量代价和 prior 适用边界。
analysis.methodZh: 本次 v2 保留 6 月 v1 的 camera aggregation 方法和主表，新增 SDS/MVDream 对照、多视角 prior 的 aggregation 负结果、五个 VLM judge 及重新设计的 seed 核验；实质价值是扩展证据并收紧适用范围。 NeRF每步Kcamera共享t/noise，默认azimuth+180°同elevation pair，顺序render/backprop1/K梯度，stepindexedwarmups也除K。论文把cameraaxisaggregation与retrainedmultiviewprior拆开，43promptmatchedbudget比较K2uniform/antipodal/K4及polarvariants，另SDS/MVDream/FLUXnegativechecks。Mainmetrics支持SD2.1本build的alignmenttradeoff；measuredgradientvariance并非一致1/K，antipodal不比uniform更低。MVDream更强且追加aggregation恶化、FLUX未成功，seedsubset异质与qualitydrop限制普适结论。
methodFlow: 采样分层views：K2默认camera及azimuth180°twin，同elevation/radius；K4multiplepairs或azimuth/elevation、K6octa用于samplingaxis实验。
共享noise的per-view distillation：每个viewrenderNeRF并经frozenSD2.1 SDI inversion/re-denoising，形成parameter-spacegradient；不fine-tuneprior。
memory-neutral accumulation：每viewlossscale1/K顺序backprop，Kview后一步Adam；totalview/UNetbudget匹配，所有stepindexed schedules除K，不产生K倍wall-clock省时。
analysis.experimentsZh: 43SDIprompts×50views主要single-seed，10promptpilots和30DreamFusionprompts另protocol；3converged/5stresspromptseedsubset不同raybudget；五VLMcounterbalanced2AFC860decisions不是humanstudy。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告K2anti/uniformCLIP均0.312，Rprec83.8/83.7；antiIQA0.431vs0.407、IR−0.07vs−0.15，少一divergence；baseline本身0%divergence。（PDF p.5, Table1）；作者报告MVDreammatched10promptCLIP0.326vsfrozenK4 0.310、IR/quality更好；额外groupaggregation损害主要alignment。（PDF p.8, Tables7–8） 对照范围：同buildSDIcontrolled最可靠；externalSDS/SJC/VSD/ESD/HiFA是publishedtranscription，10%reproductiongap不能transportrelativegain。MVDream与SDS另10prompthead-to-head，subsetdistractors不可与43promptRprec比较。 消融与诊断：K/plane/elevation/uniformpairing/TV/CW/CFG/schedule/randomaxis/seed/convergence和priorchecks充分但pilot小；数值及文字有误如SDS HPS0.213→0.210却称全preference提升，seed表five但正文three，未当普适结论。
analysis.insightZh: cameraaxis MonteCarlo averaging/stratification是核心，借助经典sampling而非新diffusionbackbone。它隔离sampling与prior贡献的实验有参考价值，‘antithetic’主要coverage不是负相关variancegain；加入CWscalar不保证不会regress实际metrics。
analysis.evidenceZh: K倍steps减少在固定budget下不等于wall-clockaccelerator。（PDF pp.3–5, Figure2/Algorithm1/Table1; pp.7–8, §4.7; p.14, AppendixA）；mainalignment收益伴显著IQA质量代价。（PDF p.5, Table1; p.17, Table12）；theoretical1/K与实际测量范围需区分。（PDF pp.14–15, AppendixC/Figure7）；generalization和几何改善并非全面成立。（PDF pp.6,8–10, Tables3/6–9; pp.16–20, AppendicesF/I/J/L/M）；Exact-version 科学差异：v1 已有 K-view/antipodal 方法、主表、TV/CW pilot、30-prompt 和 FLUX 负结果；v2 新增 plain SDS、MVDream head-to-head 及 M=1/2/4 matched-budget aggregation，新增 43-prompt 五 judge counterbalanced 2AFC，并将 seed pilot 改为 baseline/MV-SDI 五 seeds、三个 converged prompts。新结果反驳对 retrained prior 的无条件可叠加收益，也撤回将 build 内增益移植到外部 SOTA 排名的做法。（prior 2606.29964v1 PDF pp.3–9/12–18 vs current 2606.29964v2 PDF pp.6–10/15–19）
analysis.caveatZh: SD2.1prior的polarviews弱，sampling不创造missingviewknowledge；只有NeRF验证。；CLIP-IQA三anchors下降；FLUXSDI移植失败。；VLMjudge不是humanstudy，normalmapshape无显著优势；seedstresssubset不能复现全43gain。；1/K是conditionalideal，共享t/noise与跨view相关影响实际variance；coverage机制仅有限controls支持。；shapeJanusproxy弱，geometryimprovement/qualityloss归因均不充分；TV失败不证intrinsicprior。；matchedcall/step/wallclock必须分开，多个text/tablestatements不完全一致；全部结果作者报告未复现。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接影响optimization-based3D生成的cameraaxis与multi-viewconsistency，原理可迁移3D生成训练设计；high/deep读budget/variancecontrols比headline更有价值。
